primary_estimand: Paper-wide: secreted-protein (extracellular fluid proteome) changes with acute exercise, MCK-PGC1a and cold. The only RNA-seq (GSE216094) estimand is PSAP-adenovirus vs GFP-adenovirus transduction in primary iWAT adipocytes in vitro (Fig 5G/H, S5.3.20.2.p1); it is not an exercise contrast.
planned_contrasts: RNA-seq: pAd PSAP vs pAd GFP in primary iWAT adipocytes, n=4 vs 4 (Fig 5G-H; GEO data_processing 'PSAP pAd/GFP pAd'); paper reports only GSEA Hallmark (OXPHOS q < 0.001), no DEG count
Exercise vs sedentary gastrocnemius EF proteome (S2.2.p3-p4, Fig 2E; 1322 proteins q < 0.05, TMT MS, Perseus t-test) - proteomics in PRIDE PXD031982/PXD037731, not in GSE216094

paper_threshold.source_locator: S5.3.11.p1 (proteomics q < 0.05, permutation FDR); RNA-seq DEG threshold not stated (S5.3.20.2.p1), GSEA q < 0.001 Fig 5H

paper_method: RNA-seq: STAR counts -> DESeq2 v1.22.1 (VIPER), GSEA preranked by fold change, TPM > 5 filter (S5.3.20.2.p1). Exercise data: TMT proteomics, Perseus Student t-test + permutation FDR (S5.3.11.p1).
sample_inclusion: GSE216094: 8 primary iWAT adipocyte cultures, 4 GFP pAd, 4 PSAP pAd, WT, 3 days post transduction (GEO characteristics)
paper_results: RNA-seq: top upregulated Hallmarks include oxidative phosphorylation (Fig 5G-H); no DEG count reported.
